mode: expanded incremental discovery (1200-cell ceiling, 120 m grid, pagination); existing photo records are preserved unchanged
incremental_policy: Only unseen photo IDs are appended. Existing photo rows and downloaded image files are left unchanged; IDs already present are skipped.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the area derived from imported building footprints, the public API response, and up to 1200 sampled spatial cells; this expanded search cannot guarantee the provider exposes every city photo.
Image URLs and raw API records are indexed when exposed by the API; image binaries are not automatically downloaded by this metadata script.
GPS points and sequence metadata describe capture coverage, not verified road signs or extracted lane/traffic-sign detections.
